title: The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture

abstractEnglish: For every fixed integer d ≥ 3, we prove that every set of n ≥ 2 distinct points in ℝd determines at least $`c_d n^{2/d}`$ distinct distances, where $`c_d\gt 0`$ depends only on d. This resolves the higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture positively.
